blocks.x: Ruts don’t stand a chance today. Mars and Uranus reach their sextile, handing everyone the courage to try something new at work or at home. Saturn, still working its way toward a trine with Mars, lends that courage some staying power. Meanwhile, the Moon spends the day in Virgo, keeping all that daring grounded and practical, stargazer. A Moon-Uranus square could scramble at least one plan, so stay flexible. Sweet sextiles from the Moon to Venus and Mercury keep conversations easy and warm, extending the glow from last night’s Mercury-Venus meetup. Mars and Venus are creeping toward Saturday’s square, so flirting and frustration may get tangled. Be bold, and be kind about it.
Read your horoscope for the week, and see what the stars have in store for your sign today.

Boredom at work has you climbing the walls lately, and your patience is shot. Mars sextiles Uranus today, handing you the guts to shake things up, Aries. Volunteer for the scary new project or float that wild idea in the next meeting. Saturn’s building trine with Mars means you’ve got the stamina to see it through. Your restless streak is an asset here.

That person you love keeps begging for a night out, while every cell in your body wants pajamas. Mars squares Venus, so the tug-of-war might turn testy, Taurus. The Moon sextiles Venus from fellow earth sign Virgo, though, making compromise easy. With Venus retrograde, an old favorite spot is the perfect pick. Agree to a short outing there, then head home together.

Some top-tier gossip is headed your way today, and you’ll be dying to pass it along. Pluto’s square to Mercury is on its way out, but it still makes secrets extra tempting to share, Gemini. The Moon sextiles Mercury later, making it easy to use your words for good. Steer the chat somewhere kinder. Your reputation and your friendships will thank you.

Routine keeps you sane, so a surprise curveball today could rattle you. The Moon squares Uranus, scrambling plans you worked hard on, Cancer. Let yourself be annoyed for a minute. Then the Virgo Moon helps you rework the schedule like a pro. Sextiles to Venus and Mercury bring a kind word or a helping hand when you need it most.

That micromanager breathing down your neck has tested every ounce of your royal patience. Saturn’s opposition to the Sun is finally easing off, Leo, and the power struggle is cooling with it. The Sun in Libra favors diplomacy right now. Kill them with kindness, then ask for more say in how things get done. They’ll be glad to hand over the reins.

Even your hobbies somehow double as productivity projects. That knitting habit turned into a side hustle, and your walks have step goals. With the Moon in your sign, today belongs to you, Virgo. Its square to Uranus tempts you toward something random, and its sextile to Mercury keeps your busy brain calm enough to enjoy it. Do something pointless and fun. No spreadsheet required.

Other people’s anniversary posts have you side-eyeing your own love life. Mars squares Venus, stirring up frustration, while Pluto’s square makes the comparison game hard to quit, Libra. Venus retrograde has you doubting your choices, but those couples posted their best angle. The Moon sextiles Venus from practical Virgo, though, helping you notice what’s good in your own story. Fairy tales are overrated anyway.

Someone close is going to ask for your honest opinion, and you’ve never been one to soften the truth. Retrograde Pluto squares Venus from Aquarius, giving your words extra edge. Venus and Mercury are both in your sign, though, Scorpio, handing you the tact to deliver hard truths gently. Start with what you love about it. They’ll hear the rest, too.

Hot takes fly out of you faster than anyone can fact-check them. Jupiter sits this one out again, but the Moon in Virgo squares your sign, asking for evidence before you pick a side, Sagittarius. Mars sextiles Uranus, so you’ll want to go all-in on a gut reaction. Read past the headline. Your instincts are great, and facts make them bulletproof.

That new coworker has been trying to win you over for weeks, and you’ve kept things strictly professional. The Moon in Virgo trines your sign, softening your guard a little today, Capricorn. Uranus sextiles Saturn too, which favors new connections. Saturn is retrograde, so let trust build at your own pace. Accept the next invite. You might gain a great friend.

Small talk with ordinary folks has always left you feeling like an alien. Mars sextiles Uranus today, giving you the push to find the oddballs who speak your language, Aquarius. Retrograde Uranus has you craving belonging lately. The Moon squares Uranus, so nerves might flare at the last minute. Sign up for the improv class or the stargazing meetup anyway. Weird loves company.

Every dreamer needs a friend with a label maker, and you’ve definitely got one. The Moon in Virgo sits across from your sign today, putting that organized person front and center, Pisces. With Neptune retrograde, you can finally admit a few things are slipping through the cracks. Let them help sort out the mess. Thank them with something heartfelt and handmade.
